content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? There are plenty of ad-free, no-in-app-purchase games on the App Store.

Apple Arcade is a family-friendly subscription service, but it's not your only option. If you're already a Netflix subscriber, you have access to some great iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription already includes a ton of iPhone and iPad games

Now, no matter which Netflix plan you choose, you can access a massive library of mobile and TV games.

Including the cheapest 'Standard with Ads' plan at $8.99 per month.

No matter which Netflix plan you choose, you can play mobile and TV games that are ad-free, with no in-app purchases and no extra fees.

As for TV games, Netflix offers a dedicated app for iPhone and iPad called Netflix Game Controller.

This app turns your phone or tablet into an input device to play games with supported Netflix smart TV apps. If you want to level up your mobile gaming experience, a controller designed specifically for iPhone would be an even better choice.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Playground, designed for kids, offering mini-games. There's also Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond these, there are over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download them from the App Store and log in with your Netflix email and password to play.
